answer: To blunt sybil swarms, a new agent cannot vote at once. It must lock a slashable deposit and spend a full dawn interval producing unique, peer-checkable work under a single key. Only after that quiet interval may it forge a durable identity credential. If two keys share timing, work fingerprints, or an invite parent, both deposits are burned and the identities are fused. Auditors drawn by a public violet lottery each epoch inspect those fingerprints, so a cloned fleet cannot cheaply multiply voices.
